ios.desc:
Vibes reads emotions during conversation to help improve emotional communication and shared understanding. Vibes is the first emotional subtitle app for Apple Watch, buzzing emotions with real-time haptic and visual feedback. Use Vibes to improve your emotional perception when speaking with people from different demographics. Vibes can also be used to better understand your own vocal tone in conversations.

Vibes was created to improve emotional connection and friendship across diverse communities of people, while supporting the power of each person’s unique voice.

Vibes uses only on-device processing, so all vocal data and emotional classifications cannot be accessed by Vibes or a third party. Vibes currently only supports North American English speakers, including age, gender, race, neurotype, geography and communication style diversity within North American English.

NOTE: Vibes currently only supports Apple Watches Series 4 or later, running watchOS 8. Vibes is not yet available for older Apple Watches or as a standalone iPhone app.

VIBES FEATURES

EMOTIONAL ANALYSIS
* Experience real-time emotional labels updated every 10 seconds of speech
* Each emotional subtitle has an associated color, shape, and vibration, with a percentage of confidence displayed
* Feel the discrete haptic feedback for each emotion without needing to look down at your Apple Watch
* The current version of Vibes performs optimally in quiet environments and may be less accurate in louder settings

EMOTIONAL GLOSSARY
* Tap through each emotion's associated vibration and color to train yourself to understand them

Subscription pricing and terms:
Vibes offers an auto-renewing monthly subscription at $8.99/month and an auto-renewing yearly subscription at $89.99/year with the first year discounted to $49.99.

Payment will be charged to the credit card connected to your iTunes Account when you confirm the initial subscription purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current subscription period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and the cost of the renewal will be identified. You may manage your subscription and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Account Settings after the purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription, where applicable.

quotes.text:
I made a tonal analysis app with the goal of translating emotions across neurotypes and accents to improve emotional communication.

Our ML model runs on edge on the Apple Watch and was trained on representative datasets of the vocal diversity of North American speakers, taking into account race, gender, geography, age, and neurotype.

More about VIBES:

Introducing Vibes for Apple Watch! Vibes reads emotions during conversation to help improve emotional communication and shared understanding. Vibes is the first emotional subtitle app for Apple Watch, buzzing emotions with real-time haptic and visual feedback. Vibes was created by Valence Vibrations to improve emotional connection and friendship across diverse communities of people, while supporting the power of each person’s unique voice. You may even understand your own emotions better via Vibes.

Vibes only uses on-device processing, so all vocal data and emotional classifications cannot be accessed by Vibes or a third party. Vibes currently only supports North American English speakers and Apple Watch Series 4 or later. Other languages and devices are coming soon.

We have a free 1 week trial active and I'm happy to extend it for folks in this community if there's interest.
